customer_duplicate_policy.match: customer_name normalized by NFKC, trim, collapsed whitespace and vi-VN case-insensitive comparison
customer_duplicate_policy.retain: first source row in immutable source order
customer_duplicate_policy.reference_action: map duplicate customer_source_key references to retained source_key
customer_duplicate_policy.conflicting_duplicate_fields: do not overwrite retained Customer; retain duplicate-row disposition in normalization evidence

item_code_collision_policy.retain: first source row keeps original item_code
item_code_collision_policy.duplicate_action: append the lowest available two-digit ordinal to the original code, starting at 01
item_code_collision_policy.collision_guard: never overwrite a code that already exists in the original source or was already assigned

explicit_non_scope.reason: journal item-code strings that differ from the item master are alias/reference gaps, not duplicate item_code collisions; they still require canonical reconciliation

preview_rule: apply identity normalization before validate-pilot-batch; normalized datasets must still satisfy unique keys, resolved references and zero unexplained variance
